ComfortLine · 300+ km

When a bespoke transfer makes sense

A long journey may be useful for families with children, travelers with several bags, airport connections and people needing multiple agreed stops. For groups, vehicle capacity and rest requirements are checked before a quote.

A pickup that is actually specified

Provide a street address, hotel entrance or flight and terminal—not just the city name.

A vehicle matched to your group

State adults, children, child seats, bags and any accessibility requests. Vehicle model is subject to confirmation.

Cross-border feasibility before payment

We review current checkpoint access, transport permissions and passenger documentation; no border outcome can be guaranteed.

A quote for the entire journey

Ask about the complete price, currency, waiting, overnight stops, additional stops and cancellation before accepting.

What affects the price and travel time?

A journey of 300 km or more is not priced like a metered local taxi. Distance alone is not enough: pickup and final address, operating border checkpoint, expected waiting, driver rest, number of passengers, luggage, requested vehicle and any additional stops can change feasibility and cost. We do not publish fictitious fixed fares or guaranteed border-queue times.

Request a long-distance quote

Questions about journeys 300+ km

Do you provide taxis or transfers for more than 300 km?

You may request a long-distance, chauffeur-driven private transfer. The precise itinerary is subject to vehicle availability, legal operating permissions, routing and a tailored price quote.

Can I book from Europe to a Belarusian city other than Minsk?

Yes, you can request another final address and explore the Belarus destination directory. Feasibility depends on the route and current border requirements.

Can I arrange a trip within the EU without entering Belarus?

You can submit such a bespoke request; the team must first verify whether the route and applicable transport authorizations allow it. No blanket service availability is promised.

Are long-distance transfers available in both directions?

You can enquire about both directions, but the vehicle, driver permissions and applicable border rules may differ, so each direction is checked separately.

Official border and entry requirements can change at short notice. Review current government sources before departure.
